exposes.name: Nightlight starting delay
exposes.description: This attribute defines the time before the nightlight begin. This value is set in seconds.

exposes.name: Nightlight starting brightness
exposes.description: This attribute defines the dimming value at the start of the nightlight. This value is set in %.

exposes.name: Nightlight ending brightness
exposes.description: This attribute defines the dimming value at the last step of the nightlight. This attribute must be lower than 0x000D : Nightlight starting brightness. This value is set in %.

exposes.name: Nightlight ramp time
exposes.description: This attribute defines the ramp duration of the nightlight. The ramp is running after the end of the starting delay and until the ending bright is reached. This value is set in seconds.

exposes.name: Nightlight on time
exposes.description: This attribute defines the total duration of the nightlight. It must not be lower than 0x000F : Nightlight ramp time. This value is set in seconds.

exposes.name: Favorite position 1

exposes.name: Favorite position 3

exposes.name: Step controller mode
exposes.description: This attribute enables or disables the 2-step controller mode. This mode enable product to run without any ramp before and after ON or OFF. It acts like a relay.

exposes.name: Memory position mode

exposes.name: Step down

exposes.name: Step continuous
exposes.description: This attribute defines the value of each step during a dimming loop. This value is set in %.

exposes.name: Step nightlight
exposes.description: This attribute defines the value of each step during the ramp down of the nightlight mode. This value is set in %.
